items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: He worked with Arthur Godfrey for a while.

ctx.x: terrific. And it move from you, to the other guy, one guy will do something, will make that wow! You say man, listen to that! And it might be some other musicians in there, or publishers, something like -- what the hell is that? What was that? Do it again. Oh man, and then you'd get -- I'd put it on paper, and getting ready to sell it to him, because he's going to sell it right back to you at the end of the week, because he -- (laughs). They'll raise it, and it'll come out in the stock form. See?

He worked with Arthur Godfrey for a while. You know who I'm talking about? (Snaps fingers.) The publisher? Wrote more tunes, what was that? Hmmm, hmmm, hmmmmm, made millions, guy with tunes, and he's arranger here. He -- Martin Block. Not Martin Block.
I remember Archie Bleyer, if that's the guy you're talking -- Archie Bleyer?
